annotations.title: Adjusted net income and the £100k trap

description: Adjusted net income from salary, other income, pension contributions and Gift Aid: how much personal allowance is lost above £100,000, what that costs, any Child Benefit charge, and the true marginal rate on the next pound. Use for 'am I in the £100k trap', 'what does earning £110k really cost me'.

children.description: Children Child Benefit is claimed for. Defaults to 0.

giftAid.description: Gift Aid donations, the amount actually given - the charity's 25% top-up is added. Defaults to 0.

grossSalary.description: Gross salary, in pounds a year.

otherIncome.description: Other taxable income - rental, dividends, interest, bonuses. Defaults to 0.

pensionContributions.description: Gross personal pension contributions this year. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_adjusted_net_income
title: Adjusted net income and the £100k trap
